ranks: Re-keys from the second lanes run (2026-11-13/14, author-top-cards overnight lanes): cards whose recorded key was built tonight for another card but which need a different shape, so `cards:needs -- --stale` doesn't offer them as freed; plus the one card an agent found major.

blocked.name: North Star
blocked.why: cost:spend-mana-as-any-color was built for Grell Philosopher as a grant-tied spendAs (`grant-activated-of` `spendAs`); North Star's is player-scoped, for one spell this turn, and any type rather than any colour.

blocked.name: False Dawn
blocked.why: Its spend clause is player-scoped and timed (white mana as any colour until end of turn), not the grant-tied spendAs Grell Philosopher built; the colored-to-white production replacement is still open.

blocked.name: Oath of Kaya
blocked.why: trigger:opponent-attacks-your-planeswalkers was built for Mila once per declaration (`attackingYourPlaneswalkers`); Oath of Kaya triggers once for each planeswalker attacked (its ruling).

blocked.name: Tahngarth, First Mate
blocked.why: `is-attacking` (Midnight Crusader Shuttle) puts a creature into combat attacking a named player; Tahngarth also needs control given to the attacking opponent until end of combat and the defender chosen by you among those that opponent is attacking.

blocked.name: Deification
blocked.why: static:planeswalker-zero-loyalty-survives (Sanctum Lurker) doesn't cover it: Deification's is a damage replacement that removes all but one loyalty counter.

blocked.name: Curie, Emergent Intelligence
blocked.why: The replacements-copies agent (2026-11-13) found no cost for 'exile another nontoken artifact creature you control' read back as the copy's source; B322 thought it built — check first.

blocked.name: Pulmonic Sliver
blocked.why: An optional replacement for going to the graveyard ('you may put it on top of its owner's library instead') must be asked before every battlefield-to-graveyard move (SBAs, destroy, sacrifice), with ordering when several go at once (its ruling): a new kind of decision, like 903.9b's commander deferral.
